analysis:
Examined all three CLI-reference excerpts and the complete file change map. The sole change is a documentation row at docs/provider/cli-reference.md head line 1960 (visible in the patch): DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS selects complete checkpoints instead of deltas for explicit disabling values and is listed as daemon environment passthrough. No executable control change or concrete security regression is established by this documentation addition. Surrounding evidence covers cache activation/storage, credential separation, attestation, model-switch settlement and lifecycle fencing; those statements are unchanged and do not establish implementation correctness.
Integration should reconcile the new row with provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Service/LaunchAgent.swift and KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift, then examine incremental checkpoint writing/restoration under T-041, TB-007 and A-001. Material contracts to verify include authenticated dependency/model/layout/account-scope binding, HMAC-only prompt-derived disk identities, bounded reconstruction and staging memory, TTL/eviction of dependent checkpoints, corruption fallback, and preservation of cache-disable semantics. The supplied excerpts contain no implementation of delta persistence or passthrough, so these remain coverage questions, not observed missing controls. The canonical T-041 detail describes DBK3 authentication and scope isolation but does not establish that incremental dependencies preserve them.
